statement: All three-primary class groups of M_d=Q(zeta3,17^(1/3^d)) and F_d=Q(17^(1/3^d)) vanish. Three explicit ordinary units give the full four-place reciprocity hyperplane at every height through the actual Kummer corestriction norm square. The adjacent ordinary-unit norm cokernels are C3^3 over M and C3 over F. Every compatible pure divisor has a coherent completed multiplicative lift. The entire pure norm system is a split extension of Z3^3 plus the restricted module at primes with v3(ord_p17)=0 by a countably infinite product of Z3, with specified character and divisor maps. Combining it with E107 evaluates the complete global H section set with first class kappa3(17), and with every unit multiple of that first class. The exact second toric image is the restricted Kummer module on {3,17} and primes with v3(ord_p17)<=1; every fiber and inverse coordinate map is given explicitly.
where_proved: sections/E_pure_tower_complete.tex, E110.1--24 and complete proof; code/e110_bundle/code/e_pure_tower.py and e_pure_tower_base.gp with complete outputs and binary certificate.
manuscript_passages: LM section51.16, folios733v--736v, scans172--178, equations371--379, through the actual positional norm and scaled toric maps.
notes: The all-level class induction uses a proved norm square and the finite three-group fixed-point argument. The pure compact unit group is evaluated with actual finite-level norm-character maps and a chosen Pruefer basis; no stabilization of a finite unit projection is asserted. Compactness is applied only to unit fibers, not to the restricted divisor module. The global H result is complete at the specified first classes. Its image from intrinsic metabelian/marked sections is governed by their actual quotient maps and is not identified with the whole H set. E.110 proves all pure-tower three-class groups zero and evaluates every coherent pure divisor and its unit kernel through exact norm-character maps. Combining the pure and complex factors gives the complete actual H section space over kappa3(17) and every unit multiple, with second toric support at3,17 and primes satisfying v3(ord_p17)<=1, and every explicit inverse fibre. Other first classes and the intrinsic metabelian/marked source image remain active. Completed full audit and exact replay scopes are in the attached root/peer records.
